Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 3. Warranty Bidder / OEM has to give an undertaking that after expiry of warranty period, it will provide Comprehensive Maintenance Service for next 5 years for the offered products at the rate not more than 5 % of contract price per annum. Buyer reserves the right to enter into a CMC agreement with the Successful Bidder / OEM after expiry of the Warranty period at above mentioned rate and the payment for the CMC charges would be made Quarterly after rendering of the CMC Services of the relevant CMC period. Performance Security of the successful bidder shall be forfeited if it fails to accept the CMC

contract when called upon by the buyer. CMC would include cost of All required spare parts (Upload the undertaking). The original Performance Security of contract will be returned only after submission and verification of AMC Performance Security for 10% of total CMC value valid up to CMC period plus 2 months (if there is no other claim). 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 5 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The L1 firm will have to sign the Integrity pack in due course of time.

4. The experience should be continuous of 03 years OR 03 out of 05 years alongwith Crack/Installation/workin g satisfactory report. 5. Only representations/correspondence submitted via GeM shall be accepted. Any external representations/ correspondence made outside GeM shall not be accepted. 6. Equipment should be quoted as per the specification attached at ATC. 7. Sampling rate of minimum 512 Hz ADC or higher. 8. Common Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) of minimum 110 dB. 9. Input impedance of minimum 10 MΩ. 10. Should have an adjustable digital High Cut Filter (range inclusive of 0.5–100 Hz) and Low Cut Filter (range i nclusive of 0.1–7 Hz). 11. System should be capable of simultaneous EEG, amplitude-integrated EEG (aEEG), FFT power trend, and B urst Suppression Ratio (BSR) monitoring/display, essential for evaluation of neonatal encephalopathy, HIE, and therapeutic hypothermia monitoring. 12. Should have the following facilities: g. Networking capability, DICOM and HL7 compatible with HIS/PACS. i. Trend review over 72–96 hours. 13. Amplifier should have inbuilt electrode connections and should be supplied with a standard 10-20 elect rode junction box. 14. The equipment should be compatible with 220–240 V AC, 50 Hz, single-phase power supply. 15. The machine should have an inbuilt battery or should be supplied with a UPS having maintenance-free batteries providing a minimum backup of 30–60 minutes. 16. The machine should be US FDA or EUROPEAN CE, ISO 13485 and IEC 60601 approved or equivalent BIS standard. 17. with alarms 1. Should have a low battery/UPS power failure indicator. 2. Should have an electrode/lead disconnection (poor contact) indicator. 3. Should have a signal artifact/noise quality indicator. 4. Should have a video camera disconnection indicator. 5. Should have a storage full warning. 18. Prices so quoted should be frozen for 10 years including warranty. 19. Warranty period: 5 years, and CAMC for 5 years after warranty. CAMC should cover preventive mainten ance, service visits, labour and covered replacement parts/spares, excluding routine consumables. Items c

overed under CAMC and warranty should be clearly enlisted, along with items not covered under CAMC an d warranty. 20. Original literature, and not the photocopy, should be supplied with the quotation. 21. Company should certify that the model quoted is the latest and not obsolete, and spares are available f or minimum 10 years including warranty. Frozen rate should not be more than the price of the quoted rate on the date of purchase. 22. Rate list of all the accessories/consumables should be provided separately. These rates should be frozen for next 10 years. 23. Physical demonstration of the quoted model will be taken to verify the specifications. 24. The supplier/company should install and commission the equipment, perform safety and operation che cks before handover, and provide hands-on training to designated users. 25. Provision for providing 1 loaner unit if time taken for repair is more than 14 days. 26. Authorized service personnel should visit the consignee site as per CAMC clause. 27. CONSUMABLES AND ACCESSORIES 1. Conductive electrode paste/gel – 30 (thirty) bottles (200 gm each) to be supplied with each mac hine. 2. Skin preparation/scrub gel – 30 (thirty) bottles (200 ml each) to be supplied with each machine. 3. Should be supplied with Intel® Core™ i5 processor or higher, 13th Generation or later, or equiva lent AMD processor, with a minimum of 6 physical cores and minimum base frequency of 2.5 GHz, compati ble with the supplied equipment acquisition, recording and analysis software. 4. All probes/electrodes and the camera should be covered under the standard warranty and CAMC terms specified above. 5. Company should quote the price and catalogue number for all spares/consumables likely to be r eplaced during the CAMC period. . 6.
